## Definition of Ready

- [ ] Story written in role/capability/benefit form
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are demonstrable
- [ ] MoSCoW priority set
- [ ] Any ADR it depends on is **accepted**, not drafted
- [ ] Small enough to finish in one branch
- [ ] Any product owner decision it needs has been answered
